title: The 3 Body Mirror: Exact Return, Fibonacci Conjugacy, and the Nonlinear Boundary
description: A scoped mathematical treatment of an exact reversing symmetry of the planar Newtonian three-body flow, a specified hyperbolic variational conjugacy to Fibonacci transport Q^2, its analytic stable/unstable cross, and the independently checked nonzero fourth-order resonant obstruction. The selected sampling interval is prescribed, and astronomical or biological realization remains open.
